question: Gangaur Festival is celebrated in honour of the Goddess _______ mostly by the womenfolk of Rajasthan.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Parvati.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gangaur festival is celebrated in the month of Chaitra in honor of the goddess Gauri or Parvati.**
 
• This is the festival celebrated in **Rajasthan and some parts of Gujarat.**
 
• Unmarried women worship Gouri to be blessed with a good husband while married women do this for health and a long and happy life for their husband.
 
• It starts on the first day of Chaitra, the day after Holi, and continues for 16 days.
 
• **Gangor of Jaipur is world famous.**
 
• The sweet dish called ghewar is an important dish of the Gangaur festival. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sita is an incarnation** of Goddess Lakshmi and is mainly worshipped during Diwali. She is not associated with the Gangaur Festival.
 
• Lakshmi is the goddess of wealth and prosperity and is worshipped during the festival of Diwali. She is not associated with the Gangaur Festival.
 
• Durga is mainly worshipped during the festival of Navratri which is celebrated in the Hindu month of Ashwin (September-October). She is not associated with the Gangaur Festival.
